decision: Do not publish or offer the previous screenshots, gameplay videos, social layouts, creator archive or play-and-share card as promotional material.

publicApproved.use: Adult-led educational activity, not gameplay promotion
Accurate preview of the approved adult-led educational activity

pressHero.use: Public-page atmosphere with a visible AI-generated marketing-art disclosure; never gameplay evidence

reviewFindings: Some captures were technically real but did not explain the moment to a human viewer.
The creature was too small, unreadable, missing or reduced to a placeholder-like block in weak footage.
Menus and static arrival screens were presented where a meaningful act of play should have been shown.
Several layouts were crowded, aesthetically weak or dependent on captions to explain what the image failed to show.
Automated capture and file validation were incorrectly treated as substitutes for visual judgement.
replacementRequirements: One clear subject and one understandable gameplay action or consequence.
The creature is fully rendered, visibly present and readable at phone size.
The player, creature and important obstacle or choice remain in the same understandable frame.
No debug state, placeholder, broken texture, clipped interface or unexplained visual noise.
Still frames are chosen by eye from a deliberate play session, not accepted merely because a capture script completed.
Every frame of every video is watched by a named adult reviewer at desktop and phone presentation sizes.
The caption accurately says whether the material is gameplay, a story screen, interface, renderer proof or imagined marketing art.
nextCaptureBrief: A creature visibly helping the player solve or survive one clear situation.
A readable choice followed by an on-screen change that shows why the choice matters.
A discovery moment where the player, creature and surprising world detail are all visible.
A short uninterrupted stretch of movement with no missing sprite, menu takeover or dead time.
